description: The dangerous case, and the reason no_speech_probability exists as a separate threshold from the RMS floor. This is a room-noise recording containing no speech, but Whisper has emitted a fluent, confident, entirely invented sentence -- a well-documented failure mode on non-speech input. The text is NOT empty, so a service that only checked for an empty transcript would happily return a hallucination as a clinical dictation. Both segments carry no_speech_probability above the 0.6 default, so the service must discard them and report speech_detected=false.
